Class OASchedule<R>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.viaoa.scheduler.OASchedule<R>
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Iterable<com.viaoa.scheduler.OADateTimeRange<R>>

    public class OASchedule<R>
extends Object
implements Iterable<com.viaoa.scheduler.OADateTimeRange<R>>
    Used to combine DateTime ranges that could overlap, and then iterate through them in datetime order.
